utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh right, the repair drive—what do you need from me again?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep mentioning the repair drive and let folks know we’ve got the faucet and porch step covered for now.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great — just let me know if you still need me to cover anything else for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — it’s now on Sunday at the community center. If you’d like, I can help sort out what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll check the school notices and let you know if I find anything else we need to coordinate.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Faye — I appreciate you checking. Just let me know what you find, and I’ll keep everything organized on my end.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive! Bring me the list, and I’ll check my shed for anything useful. I may need a reminder, but I’m happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Oren—I'll bring the list by and remind you what to look for. Really appreciate you checking your shed for anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Of course—just bring the list by when you can, and I’ll take another look in my shed. I may need that reminder, but I’m glad to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Noah, the repair drive is going well — I can help spread the word if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Jules — that’d be great. I’ve got my toolbox and some duct tape ready, so if you can spread the word, I’ll keep an eye out for anything else we need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll let the others know we’ve got the toolbox and duct tape covered, and I’ll ask if anyone needs anything else.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rey—that’ll help a lot. See you at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Glad to help—sounds like things are coming together. I’ll stop by later and make sure anything you need gets there safely.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Ira—that would be wonderful. See you later at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep an eye out for old screws, paint, or a working drill and tell folks to drop them off at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, that helps. I’ll look for any old tools or spare parts and bring them by.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll spread the word around the block too and make sure people know to bring anything useful by the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—how’s the repair drive going? Need me to pitch in anywhere?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, thanks — if you can help, I’m just making a list of what’s broken and who might fix each thing. Rosa said she’ll sort the rest once I send her that.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I’ll bring the old charger, spare cables, and see if I can find a busted phone too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? It’s really picking up nicely—folks are dropping off tools and spare parts by the community hall. If you want, I can keep an ear out for any new updates.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Tess — I’ll pass that along and keep listening for anyone who needs repairs or has spare tools and parts to share.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good, Nell—just let me know if you hear of anyone needing a hand, and I’ll pass along any updates I catch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I still don’t have the exact count or start time yet, but I’m checking on it. I’ll get back to you as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries, Mina—just let me know when you have it, and I can bring a few tools if needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus—I'll let you know as soon as I have the details. Your tools would definitely help if we end up short.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s kind of you, Hana. If you’re heading over, I may take you up on it and bring my small box of broken lamps.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure—just to make sure I’ve got it right, what details should I bring for the repair drive? I can help once I know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Just note that I’ve got a small box of broken lamps to send over. I’ll label it clearly and have it ready by the porch step.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll keep an eye out for tools and spare parts, and let you know if I spot anything. Happy to help out at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey—that really helps. If you spot anything useful, just let me know and I’ll keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course—I’ll let you know if I find any tools or spare parts. See you at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I still haven’t heard the exact drop-off spot for the repair drive—do you know where it’s set up yet?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I don’t have the confirmed spot yet either—just let me know as soon as it’s set, and I’ll go from there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the confirmed spot.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive if you still need hands. Just let me know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Rey — we could still use a few extra hands, and I’ll keep mentioning the repair drive to folks. I’ll let you know what’s needed as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — keep me posted, and I’ll be ready to help when you need me.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh right—what’s the main thing you need from me for the repair drive again?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what do you still need fixed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Mostly just the basics—what still needs fixing, and if you want me to bring anything. I’m happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just checking—has Noah confirmed the repair drive time and drop-off spot yet?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think so — this Saturday near the community center for drop-off. I can double-check the flyer if you want, just to make sure.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — could you double-check the flyer and confirm the exact time too? I just want to make sure I’ve got it right.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Opal — I’m still waiting on the start time and drop-off spot, so I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Pia — just let me know the drop-off spot when you hear it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Will do — I’ll keep an eye out and pass it along as soon as I get the details.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive got a nice turnout—folks really showed up for it. Did they end up getting enough help?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, it sounds like they got a solid turnout and enough hands to keep things moving. I’m glad the neighborhood came through.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great to hear—sounds like it really came together. If anything still needs hauling over, I’m headed that way later.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa—if you can keep an eye out for tools and spare parts, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep an eye out for tools and spare parts and bring them along to the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa—that really helps. I’ll get the rest of the supplies organized for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the repair drive details first? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sure — the repair drive’s for gathering tools, spare parts, and repair supplies, with drop-offs over by the community hall. I’ll spread the word around the block and put up a few invites too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn — that helps. Could you remind me of the drop-off times too?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still just hearing bits and pieces, but it sounds like Rosa’s organizing the list and someone’s checking the drop-off spot. If you’ve got the latest on where it’s set up, I’d love to hear it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m not sure on the exact spot, but Rosa’s got the list moving along and folks are pitching in. If I hear where the drop-off is, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — I’ll keep an ear out too and wait for the drop-off spot to be confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, Eli — I can spread the word to the other folks and keep the repair drive on everyone’s radar.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Jules. I’ll gather my little box of broken lamps and be ready when the porch step is open.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, Eli — I’ll keep folks posted and let you know when the porch step is ready for your lamps.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? It’s really coming together nicely—people are dropping off tools and spare parts over by the community hall. If you want, I can keep an ear out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Tess. Just let me know if they need anything else dropped off.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do—if I hear they need anything else, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 9 should work for me. I’ll check the school notices and let you know as soon as I find out where the repair drive is set up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Faye—that’s great. Just remind me when you know the spot, and I’ll bring my list and check the shed for what I can gather.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Will do — I’ll check the school notices and let you know as soon as I find the location.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Noah—that sounds perfect. See you at the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m still waiting on the exact start time and volunteer count, but I’ll check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Mina — I appreciate you checking. Just let me know once you have the start time and volunteer count.
